blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rockport Power Inc. is on track to secure a larger share of the growing retail electricity market after sealing a new five-year license. The company can continue serving contestable customers under the government’s retail electricity market framework, particularly the competitive retail electricity market, the green energy option program, and the retail aggregation program. READ: Rockport Power taps Meralco, key utilities for expansion These programs allow consumers to choose a power supplier other than the distribution utility in their area. So far, Rockport Power has expanded into the manufacturing, commercial, education, retail, food and beverage, wellness, and residential development sectors. […]...
